stem.text: ‘Black powder’ is a mixture of potassium nitrate, carbon and sulfur. The mixture reacts as shown.

A sealed tube containing black powder has a volume of $10.0\text{ cm}^3$. When all of the black powder reacts, the reaction causes a pressure of $2 \times 10^6\text{ Pa}$ and a temperature of $2500\text{ K}$.
The volume of the $\text{K}_2\text{CO}_3$ and $\text{K}_2\text{S}$ produced can be ignored.
How many moles of $\text{KNO}_3$ are contained in the sealed tube?
